name: Очень святая книга
alt: Огромная святая книга сияет так ярко, что её закладка надела тёмные очки.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, legible at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms, strong readable silhouette. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery and one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear structure and anatomy, no unintended extra parts. Subject: One enormous thick closed ivory-and-gold fantasy holy book, bright golden halo behind it, cover embossed with a large simple radiant sun motif without letters. It stands upright on a little wooden lectern; a single long crimson ribbon bookmark draped down the side has tiny dark sunglasses perched on its tip as if dazzled by the book. Chunky pages and heavy brass clasps, obvious funny scale, no religious text, no runes.
